toolbar.searchWatermark: Search URL, host, process… (or method:GET status:4xx)
toolbar.searchTip: Bare text searches URL, host, process name, exact process ID, method, and status. Prefixes limit to one field: method: -method: status: host: url: process: pid: protocol: content-type: body: is:ws|grpc|tunnel|error hide:tunnel|image. body: also searches bodies spilled to disk. Prefix a field or a word with - to exclude it (e.g. -host:cursor.sh or -cursor). Advanced edits hidden hosts and processes with more room.
toolbar.filtersTip: Edit the search and hidden hosts or processes in a larger window
toolbar.hideConnectTip: Hide opaque HTTPS tunnels (CONNECT) when Decrypt HTTPS is off
ctx.excludeHostTip: Stop decrypting this host's HTTPS. The rows stay in the list; use Hide host to remove them from view.
inspect.empty: Select a session in the grid to inspect request and response headers and bodies.
loopback.window: Allow Store apps to use this proxy

filters.searchHelp: Same search as the toolbar, with more room. Hidden hosts and processes are listed below, not in this box.
filters.hideHelp: Rows stay captured. This only hides them in the list. To stop decrypting HTTPS, use Exclude host…
filters.processSpace: A name with a space is shortened at the first word, which can also hide other names containing that word.
exclude.help: This host will still appear in the session list. Inspector will not try to read its HTTPS.
logging.help: Logs always feed Recent logs for troubleshooting. Optionally also write them to files. Save applies your choices right away.
logging.numbersInvalid: Enter whole numbers in the allowed ranges.
logging.detailHelp: Error = problems only. Warning / Information = more context. Debug = very verbose.
logging.thisRunPending: (created when the first log line is written)
logging.fileSizeHelp: When a file reaches this size, logging continues in a new file.
logging.keepFilesHelp: Older log files in the folder are deleted.
logging.diskUse: Uses at most about {0} on disk.
logging.dropped: {0} log lines were dropped because logging could not keep up.
logging.memoryHelp: Older lines drop off. This does not affect the log files.
excluded.bypassHelp: Traffic never reaches Inspector when System proxy is on. Seeded with Microsoft identity / SSO / RDP hosts. Removing them can break RDP sign-in while System proxy is enabled.
excluded.notDecryptedHelp: CONNECT stays visible; TLS stays opaque when Decrypt HTTPS is on. Seeded with certificate-pinning hosts (Dropbox, Webex).
excluded.learnHeading: Automatically not decrypt on decrypt failure
excluded.learn: Learn hosts that fail origin TLS under decrypt
excluded.learnHelp: When origin TLS fails repeatedly under decrypt, or the origin server returns 403/429, Inspector stops decrypting that host for later connections in this session. List is capped and forgotten on restart unless you promote.
excluded.learnPaused: Learning paused — existing entries kept until forgotten.
retention.maxHelp: How many requests stay in the session list. When over this, the oldest rows leave the list but remain on disk until Clear sessions or the disk space limit removes them.
retention.diskHelp: Maximum space for all saved sessions on disk (all Inspector runs). Each run uses a timestamped subfolder; oldest HAR files are deleted first when over this. Empty run folders are removed.
loopback.intro: Windows Store / UWP apps are blocked from localhost by default. Check apps that should use Inspector, then Apply. Restart each app (fully quit it) after Apply. Inspector must be running with System proxy on. Clear all removes every allow entry.
loopback.proxyStopped: Start the proxy and turn on System proxy. Store apps cannot be captured until both are on.
loopback.systemProxyOff: Turn on System proxy (Capture menu). The allow list only lets Store apps reach localhost; they still follow the system proxy.
loopback.refreshing: Refreshing system proxy so running apps reconnect…
loopback.allowedRefreshed: System proxy was refreshed so running apps reconnect. If traffic still does not appear, fully quit and reopen the app.
loopback.allowedProxyStopped: Start the proxy and turn on System proxy, then fully quit and reopen the app.
loopback.allowedSystemProxyOff: Turn on System proxy, then fully quit and reopen the app.
loopback.allowedReady: Fully quit and reopen the app to capture traffic.
loopback.clearedRefreshed: All loopback exemptions cleared. System proxy was refreshed so running apps reconnect.
loopback.clearedReady: All loopback exemptions cleared. Fully quit and reopen any app that was using Inspector.
trust.macWaitBody:
Keychain Get Info can already show Always Trust even when SSL policies were not saved (Chrome and Inspector still treat the CA as untrusted).

Force a save:
1. Keychain Access → login → Certificates → double-click Titanium Root Certificate Authority
2. Expand Trust
3. Set When using this certificate to Use System Defaults, then change it to Always Trust again
4. Close Get Info — you must get a password prompt; that writes the real SSL trust policies

This window closes automatically when those policies are detected. If you already saved, click I’ve saved Always Trust.
trust.macWaitStatus: Waiting for the certificate in Keychain…
trust.macWaitInKeychain: Waiting for saved SSL policies (toggle Always Trust, close Get Info, enter password)…
trust.macNotSaved: Always Trust display is not enough — toggle Use System Defaults → Always Trust, close Get Info, enter your password, then try Install root CA / Decrypt HTTPS again
trust.install.mac: Decrypt HTTPS requires trusting the Titanium Inspector root CA in Keychain Access (login keychain). Install now?
trust.install.linux: Decrypt HTTPS requires trusting the Titanium Inspector root CA in your user certificate store (NSS). Install now?
trust.install.windows:
Decrypt HTTPS requires trusting the Titanium Inspector root CA in your current-user Trusted Root store. Install now?

Windows may show a Trusted Root Yes/No security dialog (not UAC) — choose Yes to trust the CA.
trust.install.other: Decrypt HTTPS requires trusting the Titanium Inspector root CA on this computer. Install now?
trust.remove.mac: Remove the Titanium Inspector root CA from Keychain? HTTPS decrypt will be turned off.
trust.remove.linux: Remove the Titanium Inspector root CA from your user certificate store (NSS)? HTTPS decrypt will be turned off.
trust.remove.windows: Remove the Titanium Inspector root CA from the current-user Trusted Root store? HTTPS decrypt will be turned off.
trust.remove.other: Remove the Titanium Inspector root CA? HTTPS decrypt will be turned off.
trust.elevate.mac: User-level trust failed or was insufficient. Continue to show a macOS admin password prompt? Cancel leaves certificate settings unchanged.
trust.elevate.linux: User-level trust failed or was insufficient. Continue to show a polkit admin prompt? Cancel leaves certificate settings unchanged.
trust.elevate.windows: User-level trust failed or was insufficient. Continue to show UAC? Cancel leaves certificate settings unchanged.
trust.elevate.other: User-level trust failed or was insufficient. Continue with an admin prompt? Cancel leaves certificate settings unchanged.
trust.recovery.mac: Continue to show a macOS admin password prompt? Not now leaves certificate settings unchanged.
trust.recovery.linux: Continue to show a polkit admin prompt? Not now leaves certificate settings unchanged.
trust.recovery.windows: Continue to show UAC? Not now leaves certificate settings unchanged.
trust.recovery.other: Continue with an admin prompt? Not now leaves certificate settings unchanged.
trust.hosts.mac: OS bypass needs Capture → System proxy (uses macOS network proxy settings). Tunnel-only rules apply to every client that hits Inspector. Factory defaults are seeded into the lists below — edit freely or reset.
trust.hosts.linux: OS bypass needs Capture → System proxy (uses desktop / environment proxy settings). Tunnel-only rules apply to every client that hits Inspector. Factory defaults are seeded into the lists below — edit freely or reset.
trust.hosts.windows: OS bypass needs Capture → System proxy (uses WinINET). Tunnel-only rules apply to every client that hits Inspector. Factory defaults are seeded into the lists below — edit freely or reset.
trust.hosts.other: OS bypass needs Capture → System proxy. Tunnel-only rules apply to every client that hits Inspector. Factory defaults are seeded into the lists below — edit freely or reset.
trust.localhost.mac: When System proxy is on, send localhost through Inspector. Off adds localhost to the macOS proxy bypass list.
trust.localhost.linux: When System proxy is on, send localhost through Inspector. Off adds localhost to NO_PROXY.
trust.localhost.windows: When System proxy is on, send localhost through Inspector (WinINET <-loopback>). Off lets loopback skip the proxy.
trust.localhost.other: When System proxy is on, send localhost through Inspector.
trust.status.missing: Root CA is not trusted yet — try again, or Export CA
trust.status.certutil: Browser certificate tools are missing — install them, try again, or Export CA
trust.status.homebrew: Homebrew is required to install certificate tools — Export CA to trust manually
trust.status.macConfirm: Set Always Trust for the Titanium Inspector root CA in Keychain Access
trust.status.keychain: Keychain trust failed — try again, or Export CA and trust it manually
trust.fail.toolsLinux: Inspector needs certutil (NSS tools) to finish trusting the root CA.
trust.fail.toolsOther: Inspector needs browser certificate tools to finish trusting the root CA.
trust.fail.homebrewBody: Homebrew is required to install certificate tools. Export the CA to trust it manually.
trust.fail.title: Can't decrypt HTTPS yet
trust.fail.body: The Titanium Inspector root CA is not trusted on this computer yet.
toolbar.throttleTip: Add latency and bandwidth shaping during capture (body writes / WebSocket frames). Off by default.
toolbar.bindTip: 127.0.0.1 or localhost = this PC only. 0.0.0.0 or * = all network adapters (includes localhost).
toolbar.portTip: * or empty = OS-chosen port (the real port appears after start). Otherwise 1–65535.
toolbar.trustHealthTip: Root CA trust state for Decrypt HTTPS. Install or trust the CA if this says not trusted.
toolbar.methodTip: Uncheck a method to hide it. All checked shows every method. CONNECT is the HTTPS tunnel.
filter.methodTypedNote: Editing this list replaces a typed method: or hide:tunnel filter.
inspect.resizeTip: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.
inspect.hexTip: Show the body as a hex dump
inspect.framesHelp: Live WebSocket frames for this session (direction, opcode, payload preview).
inspect.sseHelp: Server-Sent Events parsed from the response body.
composer.help: Build and send a request through the proxy. Load from selected copies the current session.
bp.help: Pause matching client requests to edit the body, continue, or abort. One pause at a time; auto-continues after 120s. Unchecking Enabled continues a paused request.
bp.graphqlTip: Extra filter on the client request body. Matches JSON operationName or a named query. Leave blank to match every operation on the URL.
bp.fromSelectedTip: Copy the GraphQL operation name from the selected session's request.
bp.graphqlHelp: Leave the GraphQL box empty to match every operation. Fill it (e.g. GetUser) to pause only that client request on the URL above. Break on response still uses the URL filter.
bp.editWatermark: Edit body (Apply edit body, then Continue)
ar.help: Return a fake response before the real server. Match decides which client requests a rule applies to; the fields below that are what you send back.
ar.graphqlHelp: Same URL, different GraphQL operations can use different rules. Leave blank to match every operation.
ar.bodyWatermark: Response body (used when Map Local is empty)
script.intro: One command per line, on every captured session. This is not JavaScript or C# — type only the commands below.
script.setHeaderHelp: Add or replace a header. Traffic still continues to the server.
script.setStatusHelp: On request: answer now and skip the server. On response: change the status the client sees.
script.abortHelp: Block with 403 Forbidden. Add a set-status line to choose a different code.
script.comment: Start a line with # or // for a comment. You can combine commands; put each on its own line.
script.requestSkips: abort or set-status here skips AutoResponder, breakpoints, and the origin.
map.help: Rewrite matching client requests to another origin before the real server. Use a single * in match and target to preserve a path/query suffix. Runs after AutoResponder / Map Local.
map.graphqlHelp: Leave blank to rewrite every operation on the URL. Fill it to rewrite only that GraphQL operation.
network.appliesNextStart: Applies the next time capture starts.
network.hostInvalid: Enter a host name or IP address.
network.self: That address is this Inspector. Choose another proxy.
network.http3Help: To servers only. Turning off HTTP/2 does not turn this off.
network.http3Unavailable: HTTP/3 needs QUIC, which this computer does not provide.
network.summaryBoth: Browsers can use HTTP/2. Servers can use HTTP/2 or HTTP/3.
network.summaryH1: Browsers and servers will use HTTP/1.1.
network.summaryH2: Browsers and servers can use HTTP/2.
network.summaryH3: Browsers use HTTP/1.1. Servers can use HTTP/3.
network.tlsLegacyWarning: Older TLS is insecure. The operating system may still refuse it.
menu.disableCachingTip: Removes conditional request headers so every request is a full fetch.
menu.forceUncompressedTip: Asks servers to send an uncompressed body.
custom.upstreamNextStart: Custom settings restored. The upstream proxy applies the next time capture starts.
stats.notRecorded: Timing was not recorded for this session
stats.estimated: Timing estimated (imported from an older file)
stats.reused: Connection reused from an earlier request
stats.prefetched: Connection was opened ahead of the request
stats.event.cache: Caching was disabled for this request
stats.event.uncompressed: Compression was turned off for this request
stats.event.tls: The server certificate was not trusted
stats.event.opaque: Decryption was skipped for this connection
runLog.empty: Only errors are shown at the current level. Open Logging settings to see more.
runLog.needsWindow: Recent logs requires the main window
runLog.help: Shows the latest log lines kept in memory. Not a search of the log files.
logging.levelCost: Debug and Trace use more CPU. Use them only while diagnosing.
network.winAuthHelp: Signs in as this Windows account, only for hosts you list and trust. Request bodies to those hosts are buffered up to 32 MB. Plain HTTP exposes the handshake.
network.winAuthInvalid: Use a host or *.suffix on each line. No scheme, path, or port.
stats.event.winAuthTooLarge: Upload too large for Windows authentication
toolbar.statusTip: Filter by status code. One status: token, for example 2xx,304 or 500-599.
filter.statusInvalid: Ignored. Use codes, Nxx, or ranges such as 500-599. At most 32 terms.
filter.statusTooMany: Use at most 32 terms and 128 characters.
comment.title: Comment
menu.removeMatchingTip: Requires an active search or filter. Removes every session that matches, including ones hidden by a Hide chip. You will be asked first.
menu.removeMatchingNeedsFilter: Set a search or filter first. With nothing filtered this would remove every session — use Clear sessions for that.
cleanup.removeConfirm: Remove {0} sessions, including {1} hidden by the current filter?
menu.alwaysOnTopTip: Keep the main window above other windows. Some Wayland desktops ignore this.
